layout.tagline: Everything your school runs on, in one calm place.
layout.highlightAttendance: Attendance, timetables and results, always up to date
layout.highlightFees: Fees and receipts parents can trust
layout.highlightPrivacy: Student data protected and private by design
layout.footer: Protected sign-in. Never share your password or verification codes.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back. Sign in with your school email.
login.help: Trouble signing in? Contact the school office.

fields.mfaCodeOptional: Verification code (if you use an authenticator app)

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@school.in.

errors.invalid: The email or password is incorrect, or this account can't sign in right now. Check your details and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.mfaInvalid: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds — enter the current one.
errors.mfaExpired: This sign-in step has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

session.signed_out: You've signed out. See you soon!
session.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
session.idle: You were signed out after a period of inactivity, to keep your data safe.

mfa.title: Verify it's you
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your school email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a password of at least {{min}} characters that you don't use anywhere else.
reset.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.mfaHint: Required only if your account uses two-step verification.
reset.doneBody: For your security, you've been signed out on all devices. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once and expire after 15 minutes. Request a new one to continue.
